title: Explicit affine derived pullback representative and identity transport
statement: For a ring map φ:A→A′, a complex M over A and e:Q(tilde M)≅K, with invertible derived pullback counit on tilde M, define the isomorphism Q(tilde(A′ tensor_A M))≅Lp* K as the inverse unit-normalized tensor comparison, inverse derived counit, and Lp*(e), in that order. Its hom for e=id followed by Lp*(e.hom) equals its hom for e.

source.place: Affine associated-sheaf pullback, derived pullback, and naturality of the derived mate. The identity-transport equation follows from the explicit three-factor construction.

proof.text: Construct the three factors from the unit-normalized tensor comparison, invertible derived counit and representative e. For identity transport, expand the three factors and use functoriality and the category identity law.

proof_origin.place: The explicit three-factor affine representative and its counit cancellation
proof_origin.note: Names the same termwise complex comparison; component formula is reflexivity, identity transport and counit cancellation are proved by functoriality and inverse identities.

from.place: Identity representative calculation and transport in proof steps 1–3

lean.statement:
def affineBaseChangeTildeRepresentativeIso
    (A A' : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A')
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅ K)
    (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((affineTildeFunctor A').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)) ≅
      (derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj K
